title: A_f is smooth over R for every f in the singular ideal H_{A/R}
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $H_{A/R}\subset A$ the singular ideal of $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. For every $f\in H_{A/R}$ the localization $A_f$ of $A$ at $\{1,f,f^2,\dots\}$, an $R$-algebra via $R\to A\to A_f$, is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07EU (lemma-final-solve): 'A_{f_i} is smooth over R by definition of H_{A/R}', with Definition Tag 07C5 (definition-singular-ideal) and Algebra, Lemma Tag 00TC (lemma-locally-smooth)

proof.text: Unfold membership in singularIdeal R A as membership in the radical of Ideal.span (smoothElements R A). Ideal.mem_radical_iff gives n with f^n in that span. Apply Algebra.smooth_localization_span_from_radical R A f n to conclude smoothness of A_f.

split_report.summary: Proved from the definition in def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal (H_{A/R}=sqrt((G)), G={g: A_g smooth}) in three steps: f^n=sum a_i g_i with g_i in G, so the g_i generate the unit ideal of A_f (elementary, including the case A_f=0); (A_f)_{g_i} is isomorphic to A_{fg_i} and to (A_{g_i})_f as R-algebras (checked with the (a)-(c) criterion of lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization), which is smooth by lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization; then A_f is smooth by lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-local-on-cover (Stacks 00TC, Mathlib leaf RingHom.Smooth.ofLocalizationSpanTarget).
